widgets_values: dark Aesthetic oilpainting of a woman with six arm surrounded taking off 6luminous mirror masks, each one shimmering in pearlescent, pastel tones opal, mother-of-pearl, soft iridescent light. One by one, she removes and releases them, as if shedding versions of herself that the world has seen but were never truly her. What thez see is a reflection of their own. The masks float, glow, and dissolve around her, reflecting expectations, projections, and fragmented identities. At the center, her true face emerges quiet, raw, unadorned. Dreamlike atmosphere, soft cinematic lighting, poetic symbolism, surreal elegance, high-art composition. stzle of agnes cecile
